facilities.source: https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingJohnPrincePark/Features.aspx ('Four conveniently located restroom and shower buildings, four campfire pits, two playgrounds, a petanque court, and WiFi', 'On-site dump station for registered guests', 'Laundry facility'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: By phone only, 7 am-9 pm daily (561-582-7992, toll free 877-992-9925); no online booking and no same-day reservations; card payment at booking, no cash. Palm Beach County residents may book the 14-day short-term area 120 days ahead. Camping is limited to 155 days in any 12-month period, and the lakefront sites to 14 days in a 28-day period. Full refund up to a week before arrival; one night's charge after that, two on the day of arrival. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am. Motorhomes must be able to move under their own power, and the RV's RVIA certification number is asked for at check-in.

booking.source: https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/Pages/Camping-JohnPrincePark.aspx ('Reservations may be made by phone up to 90 days in advance. No same day reservations... Camping is limited to 155 days in any 12-month period'; resident 120-day special) + https://discover.pbc.gov/parks/CampingJohnPrincePark/CamperInformation.aspx ('Lakefront sites may be occupied for a maximum of 14 days in a 28 day period'; cancellation, check-in, RVIA rules), read 2026-10-21

note: Palm Beach County Parks & Rec campground on Lake Osborne, inside 726-acre John Prince Park in Lake Worth; boat ramp in the campground, no swimming. Gated (code given at check-in); manager lives on site. --Claude
